messages.subject: [Basta-users] Error with DataCheck
messages.body_plain:
I just resubmitted now that I am registered on the mailing list.


I'm new to BaSTA and am a pretty novice R user. I think my question might
be general to R and not specific to BaSTA. Either way, I am hoping the
community can point me in the right direction.

My dataset is 7700 lizards captured over 42 months in a closed island
population. There were 4 sampling periods in each year and the sampling was
close to 90% of the population captured during each sampling period (7-12
days). The vast majority of animals had lifespans shorter than 12 months.

I first constructed my Capture History, Birth/Death Matrix, and Covariate
Matrix (sex data for each individual).

Then I merged the matrices with:
inputMat <- merge(birthDeath, Y, by.x = "ID", by.y = "ID")
inputMat <- merge(inputMat, covMat, by.x = "ID", by.y = "ID")

Things seem to work OK there. I view inputMat and everything looks as it
should.

Then when I run DataCheck with:
newData <- DataCheck(inputMat, studyStart = 4, studyEnd = 46, autofix =
rep(1, 7), silent = FALSE)

I get the following error:
Error in rowSums(Y) : 'x' must be numeric

Can someone help me work on this error?

Thanks for having a look at this.

messages.subject: [Basta-users] Error with DataCheck
messages.body_plain:
Dear Aaron,

   I believe that the error is because the two matrices are read as data.frames and the values in them are not numeric. Maybe you can force Y to be a matrix by typing:

  Y <- as.matrix(Y)

   Let me know if that works.

  Best,

  Fernando

messages.subject: [Basta-users] interaction term throwing an error
messages.body_plain:
Good afternoon,

I am a PhD researcher looking at age related mortality of badgers infected with TB, I have successfully run a number of BaSTA models with a large data set using the various BaSTA functions to create the required matrices.  I then tried to add an interaction term in the MakeCovMat which created the required matrix, I then put this through DataCheck with no problem and through basta and the model runs without issue, calculates DIC but then gives the following error code and will not give me any output?

Calculating DIC... done
Survival parameters converged appropriately.
DIC was calculated.
Error in dimnames(x) <- dn :
  length of 'dimnames' [2] not equal to array extent

This is the input code for the covariate matrix...

CovMat.inf <- MakeCovMat(x= ~ sex + f + sex:f, CH.data.inf)


I am unsure as to how to go about rectifying this problem and hoping that someone may be able to offer some advice?

Many thanks

Dave


Dave Hudson

PhD Research Student

College of Life and Environmental Science

University of Exeter, Penryn.

   I believe that this is a problem in BaSTA that has to do with the way it handles the parameter names for the interactions. Could you send me a subset of the data so I can pin it down and try to fix it?
